title: 72K/h Obisidan Farm - TUTORIAL - White Mc
description:
Hope this new design will help you in your world and taht the tutorial was clear.

World Download and Litmatica (updated) :
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12k71oeAp9cs9CS1c84tCVaxwOFwv6e3V?usp=sharing

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Information to build the farm:

- The portal cords need to be the same in X,Y and Z cords. 
- Summon the wither on top of a stonecutter, a water source block on his head and an obsidian block behind him to block the vision of the wither and the opposite iron-golem).
- Attack the withers (by activating the overworld part without the nether part) once so that nothing is left of the 3x4 obsidian platform, it will break otherwise.
- Powdered snow is necessary on the sides but not in front of the withers.
- The wither part is just junk items, you can make a carpet duper…
- Loading the Nether is mandatory, using this tutorial should do the trick : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OdIN2pPuMFI

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

!!! This farm can kill you or make your game lag if not built well !!!

Music : @TheRelaxedMovement 

See you in the next one ! 
Thanks for watching !
